scope: Read-only follow-up dependency audit during v59 portable JIT. No admission or implementation claim.

effect.name: 미정령의 축복 2
effect.note: 원문 「최종 최대 장탄 수 1발 당 차지 대미지 N% ▲」 — 실효값 = values × 수령자(자신)의 실효 최대 장탄(오버로드·큐브·소장품·스킬 버프 반영). `full_charge_fire`는 `_BULLET_BOUND_TIMINGS`가 아니라 부여한 그 발은 받지 못하고 다음 발이 받는다(베스티 : 택티컬 업 `미사일 가이드` 선례).

effect.name: 대정령의 철퇴
effect.note: 원문 「자신이 가한 피해량의 N% 만큼 본체에 고정 대미지」 — 트리거한 풀차지 명중 한 발이 실제로 준 대미지 × N%를 그대로 넣는다(DealForm을 다시 타지 않는다). 「본체에」라 대상은 `target_body`(라플라스 `히어로 봄버` 계통의 `대상 본체에게`와 같은 키).

local_reference_contract: max_ammo_count reads the recipient effective maximum ammunition at query time, including equipment, weapon mode and active buffs; recursive capacity queries skip this scaling operation.
dealt_fixed_damage reads the triggering shot damage from notify context and scales it by its percentage; the reference skips defense, buffs, critical and core multipliers a second time.
The reference fixed packet does not publish its own hit-count trigger or burst energy. Impact publication still needs explicit semantic review; do not infer game behavior from CPU omission.
dependencies: Reuse current recipient_value/effective ammo and immutable parent damage query scope instead of per-character hooks.
Current CUDA notify arguments carry core/critical/heal and resumed count, but no explicit dealt-damage context. Add a typed scoped quantity if implementing captured parent damage.
Verify callback lifetime, nested replacement, missing context, bullet-limited scaling and normal max-ammo query recursion independently.
verification_selection: Independent max-ammo quantities before/after buff, weapon mode, recipient selection and depletion.
Fixed parent-damage percentages with no double application of damage multipliers and no recursive self-hit.
Reuse existing nested parent/child query tests and one raw interacting whole squad; avoid duplicating all character matrices.
